thought.title: ReduceSum 替代标量累加循环 + block_M 调优
thought.description: 将逐元素标量累加循环 for(i=0;i<N;i++) sumSq+=v*v 替换为 AscendC::ReduceSum<float> 硬件矢量归约。O(N)→O(logN)。同时 block_M 从128调为64提升小M并行度。
thought.reason: 对标 add_layer_norm 历史优化经验，标量循环在Vector处理器上O(N)开销极大，ReduceSum利用硬件矢量归约单元。
thought.target_bottleneck: 标量累加循环在Vector处理器上串行执行成为主导瓶颈

runtime.dsl_before: for (int32_t i = 0; i < t_.N; ++i) { float v = addFp32(i); sumSq += v * v; }
runtime.dsl_after: AscendC::ReduceSum<float>(reduceOut, xFp32, reduceTmp, t_.N); float sumSq = reduceOut.GetValue(0);
